description: Implementation of the gl::IndexRangeCache class, which manages index range data for rendering, including adding, finding, invalidating, and clearing index ranges.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of index ranges for rendering, supporting addition, lookup, invalidation, and clearing of index ranges.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache::IndexRangeKey
classes.description: A key used in the cache to uniquely identify index ranges based on type, offset, count, and primitive restart status.

methods.name: addRange
methods.description: Adds an index range to the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: findRange
methods.description: Finds an index range in the cache matching specified parameters.

methods.name: invalidateRange
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries overlapping a specified range.
